notes.content: Students must earn a minimum grade of "C-" or higher in all required Science Subject Matter Program courses. It is very important for students who intend to major in Physics, or obtain a single subject Teaching Credential in Science/Physics Emphasis, to complete most of the core preparatory courses listed below during their first two college years. By completing the 4 semesters of Mathematics, 3 semesters of Physics, and 2 semesters of Chemistry, students will be prepared to take upper-division Physics courses necessary for the major after transfer. For additional information, please visit: Department of Physics .
